meta.name: c-level-agents
meta.description: Founder-mode executive team. 13 cs-* C-suite agents (CFO, CMO, CRO, CPO, COO, CHRO, CISO, GC, CDO, CAIO, CCO, VPE, Chief of Staff) and 21 /cs:* slash commands for forcing-question office hours, multi-role boardroom deliberation, strategic sprint pipeline, and meta routing. Use when the founder needs a virtual executive team, when invoking /cs:* commands, or when orchestrating multi-role decisions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建虚拟高管团队辅助战略决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是创始人，需要虚拟高管团队辅助决策。
copy.tagline_en: Assemble a virtual executive team for strategic decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a founder needing a virtual executive team for decision-making.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成由 13 个虚拟高管（如 CFO、CMO 等）组成的团队。你可以用 /cs: 开头的命令让某个高管审查业务、召开董事会或制定 90 天计划。每次输出都会生成一份 Markdown 文档。
howto.when: 当你需要创始人模式下的虚拟高管团队时，比如输入 /cs: 命令（如 /cs:office-hours）或要求多角色决策时触发。

say.text: /cs:office-hours "我们该不该招一个销售副总裁？"
say.note: 启动 YC 风格的 6 问流程，帮你理清决策。
自动路由到 CFO 角色，进行财务审查。
召开全体董事会，讨论定价方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a virtual executive team of 13 C-suite agents (CFO, CMO, etc.). You can use /cs: commands to have a specific executive review a topic, convene a boardroom, or create a 90-day plan. Each output is a Markdown artifact.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a founder-mode virtual executive team, such as when invoking /cs: commands (e.g., /cs:office-hours) or orchestrating multi-role decisions.

say_en.note: Starts a YC-style 6-question intake to clarify the decision.
Auto-routes to the CFO role for financial review.
Convenes a full boardroom to discuss the pricing proposal.
